text:
Mia Chen: Quick cross-team check-in on the Optimize toolkit delivery. Goal: ship quantization recommendations + batching/caching suggestions + initial regression alerts. Can each owner confirm milestones and any blockers?
Samir Patel: I own quantization recommendations. PR is mostly ready, needs one perf test on A100 with 8-bit fallback. Targeting merge by EOD Thu. Blocker: kernel-selector change in runtime (see Eli).
Eli (eng-runtime): Confirmed — kernel selector refactor is landed in a feature branch, but we need a tiny API tweak for the quant path (kv-cache flag). I'll have a patch by tomorrow morning. No capacity problems.
Lina Gomez: I'm on batching/caching suggestions. Draft doc up: https://redir/company/optimize/batching-v1 (internal). Need to sync with infra for cache TTL defaults and S3 eviction. Target: internal alpha next Tue. Blocker: infra wants explicit metrics for hit/miss — can someone add? @Anuj?
Anuj Rao: I'll add metrics hooks and a Prometheus exporter endpoint. ETA Monday. Also working on regression-alerts integration: need the evals harness to push diff events to alerting pipeline. Question: should alerts be per-model or per-route?
Mia Chen: Prefer per-route for now (we can aggregate to model-level later). Keep config flexible.
Samir Patel: Minor note — quant PR includes suggested quant levels per family (4/8 bits) and fallback rules. We included a sample config:

```
optimize.quant:
  model_family: llama2
  preferred_bits: [4,8]
  fallback_on_quality_drop: true
```

Eli (eng-runtime): That config looks good. After my kv-cache flag patch, the runtime will expose a /capabilities endpoint which the toolkit can query at startup to decide allowed quant profiles.
Anuj Rao: For the regression alerts pipeline: plan is evals -> delta scorer -> alert rule. I'll wire a demo alert that posts to #incidents-staging and to PagerDuty for critical regressions.
Lina Gomez: For caching TTLs, infra wants to baseline at 5m for prefix cache and 1h for content cache. I'll annotate doc.
Mia Chen: Milestones recap:
- Quant recommendations merge: Thu EOD (Samir)
- Runtime API patch and /capabilities: Fri AM (Eli)
- Metrics exporter + evals hook: Mon (Anuj)
- Batching/caching doc alpha + infra signoff: Tue (Lina)
- Regression alerts demo to staging: Tue (Anuj + Lina)

Please reply with any changes to ownership or blockers. If all good, I'll post this as the cross-team weekly status. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deployment report — dev cluster had a successful deploy of runtime branch kselector-2024 at 2024-10-01T09:12:23Z. No errors flagged.
Samir Patel: Updated: ran A100 perf tests, one fallback case shows 2% quality drop on a narrow prompt distribution. I'll add a conditional flag to disable 4-bit for that workload and document tradeoff.
Eli (eng-runtime): Pushed the kv-cache flag branch: https://git.company/eng/runtime/compare/kvcache-flag. Waiting on review from @Mia Chen for the API wording.
Mia Chen: Thanks — I'll review the API doc this afternoon. If we keep the timelines, we can have an internal alpha by next Wednesday. Will follow up in a short recap thread.
